## SOL implementation decisions

Original sun wordmark; cobalt blue #0041D9; white editorial surfaces; charcoal text; 12px controls; rounded property cards; locally stored architectural imagery. Responsive desktop and mobile navigation, accessible Base UI search tabs, and existing shadcn Button.

Public 21st reference: https://21st.dev/originui/tabs. CLI search was attempted but requires account authentication. No authenticated component retrieval or hosted generation was used. External review was blocked by automatic approval review; local lint, TypeScript, build, and browser checks were used instead.

All listing cards use existing Supabase records and real provider photos. Editorial imagery is separate and identified in the footer. Existing sign-in, saving, filters, and import capabilities are preserved.

## Role-aware dashboard

SOL's application shell follows the 21st dashboard collection (https://21st.dev/community/templates/s/dashboard) and dashboard composition references (https://21st.dev/community/components/explore/next-shadcn-dashboard-starter). It uses a permanent white sidebar, pale neutral work surface, cobalt actions, compact metric cards, grouped activity bars, a portfolio donut, and a property table. Chart data also has a text table for accessibility.

Buyer, Seller, and Landlord workspaces share original SOL branding and existing shadcn Button / Lucide primitives. Public previews are labeled sample data and never call write actions. The real dashboard uses per-user Supabase records. Role changes do not alter privileged platform roles.

Desktop/tablet/mobile navigation, native modal focus handling, reduced motion, empty states, and server error feedback are maintained. Local review replaces the external 21st source-upload review previously blocked by automatic approval review.

## Dedicated landlord direction — October 2, 2026

The user's new reference selects a mint/emerald landlord dashboard: pale mint canvas, white rounded shell, horizontal navigation, an emerald gradient KPI band, large rental photography beside a pale mint financial chart, and three lower panels for tenants, reminders, and a calendar. This supersedes the shared cobalt dashboard composition for Landlord only. Buyer and Seller retain their existing interfaces.

Public 21st inspiration: https://21st.dev/community/components/explore/ui-dashboard and https://21st.dev/dhileepkumargm/analytics-dashboard. Existing shadcn Button, Lucide icons, PropertyImage, and authentication/data conventions are reused; no paid template or authenticated CLI component is claimed as installed.

Rental photos come from the selected real catalog entry. Preview tenancy and financial history are explicitly labeled illustrative. Live analytics come from the owner's private ledger, with paid/pending distinctions, per-property filtering, accessible chart tables, and empty states. Mobile navigation scrolls horizontally; panels stack and data tables scroll within their container. Native dialogs handle keyboard focus. Local browser, lint, type, build, metrics, and SQL/RLS checks cover the implementation.
